title: Model DPMI INT 31h AX=0100 DOS memory block allocation
description: Advance the measured startup trap at guest 0x001D23A7: DPMI AX=0100 Allocate DOS Memory Block, BX=0x1000 paragraphs. Build an explicit bounded conventional-memory allocator that returns a real-mode segment in AX and protected-mode selector in DX, tracks ownership and exhaustion, and never aliases the PSP block or video memory. Add unit tests for backing, selectors, failure and allocation limits; rerun original-byte -k to the next gate. If available DOS arena cannot satisfy the measured request, record exact layout evidence and split independent layout/selector work rather than invent memory.
acceptance: The AX=0100 request and 0x1000-paragraph size are verified from original target execution
Success returns consistent AX real-mode segment and DX protected selector over backed guest memory
Invalid size, selector exhaustion and arena exhaustion return errors without fabricated allocations
Unit tests cover allocation and boundary behavior
Original-byte -k advances past 0x001D23A7 or records a concrete layout blocker
